newsitem.title: BELGIUM: INSIGHT - CHARTISTS SEE BEL-20 DECLINING.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - CHARTISTS SEE BEL-20 DECLINING.

text.p: Belgian shares are expected to
move lower due to a combination of a failure to make new gains
recently and the effect of recent strong U.S. data, although the
reweighting of several Bel-20 index stocks will produce some
notable exceptions and could temper the decline, chartists said.
Kredietbank and Petrofina were among those likely to
outperform the market as their weighting is due to be raised,
while UCB and Bekaert were seen likely to fall further due to
their weighting being reduced.
The Bel-20 ended at 1,714.31 last Friday, well down from its
August 23 close of 1,767.53.

Contributors' own analysis:
CERA - Last week, Belgian stocks were negatively influenced
(more than three percent over the past five sessions) by U.S.
markets amid concern that robust economic growth will bring
higher interest rates. Over the next few days the Bel-20 will be
influenced by first half corporate results (eg. banks). A first
resistance is at 1,750. A second at the last high of 1,773 (on
28/5/96). We believe there is a first strong support at the
1,700 level. In our opinion, stocks that will have their
weighting increased in the index (eg. Kredietbank and
Petrofina), which takes effect on September 20, will outperform
the market in coming days. -- Guy Sips
ECOFIS - In the weekly chart the long black candle of last
week and the full-line stochastics having cut its ironed-out
dotted-line version from above, plead for further falls. The
fact that this happened at previous highs between 1,750 and
1,800, strengthens the presumption that the Bel-20 is in an
extended top formation. The window made between Thursday and
Friday last in the daily chart is also bearish. In the very
short run some pause is possible due to strong oversoldness in
the daily stochastics.
-- Frank Boll
BANK DEGROOF - The market has been unable during the
holidays to cross the last highs. Technically after the recent
U.S. figures and corporate results we should see the downtrend
resuming, with our old objectives around 1,650-1,630. OTC
closings and the reshuffle of the index later in the month could
temporarily affect this move.
-- Joel Crevecoeur
GENERALE BANK - The weakening of the upward trend after the
unsuccessful attempt to break through the Bel-20 year high
suddenly changed into a clear negative trend once the
1,745-1,755 consolidation range was abandoned. Also noteworthy
is that turnover on the negative days largely exceeded turnover
in the last few weeks when market sentiment was a lot more
optimistic. The support level at 1,710 is not very strong, and a
revisiting of the July lows at 1,650 holds high probability
-- Geert Vanderbeke
